name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
summary: At Oracle Glade on Teldrassil, Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak watches over the northern groves. She guards the enchanted waters and woodland wildlife.

sections.title: Watcher of the Oracle Glade
sections.body: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak keeps watch in Oracle Glade, one of Teldrassil's most secluded reaches. Far from Darnassus, she serves the Sentinel army among ancient trees and ethereal springs, guarding the wilderness from disturbance.

sections.title: Trouble in the Glade
sections.body: Disharmony stirs among Teldrassil's creatures despite the tree's sacred birth. Arynia asks passing adventurers and young night elves to look into local troubles, from strange wildlife to mystical signs around the enchanted springs.

faq.answer: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak is a night elf Sentinel guarding Oracle Glade in northern Teldrassil. She watches over the glade and asks travelers to help preserve its natural harmony.

faq.q: Where can Arynia Cloudsbreak be found?
faq.answer: Arynia Cloudsbreak keeps watch in the open at Oracle Glade, in northwestern Teldrassil, north of Dolanaar.

faq.q: What duties does she perform in the Sentinels?
faq.answer: Arynia patrols the outlying forest boughs and watches local spirits, wildlife, and natural phenomena for signs of corruption or imbalance.

faq.q: Is she related to anyone else on Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Arynia Cloudsbreak shares her surname with Mavoris Cloudsbreak, suggesting a family bond among the night elves who dwell on the world tree.

faq.q: What tasks does she give to adventurers?
faq.answer: Arynia asks travelers to investigate the enchanted glade, tend to mysterious disturbances and wandering beasts nearby, and aid creatures in distress.

faq.q: Why is the Oracle Glade significant to the night elves?
faq.answer: Night elves revere Oracle Glade as a sacred sanctuary in Teldrassil, known for tranquil pools. Druids and Sentinels watch over it, seeking nature's guidance and omens.

angles.text: As a young night elf coming of age on Teldrassil, helping Sentinel Cloudsbreak gives you practical experience protecting your new homeland's wild balance.
As an Alliance member, you see Arynia uphold the Kaldorei Sentinels' watch over the Alliance's vital woodland stronghold in Kalimdor.
